answer: A juror that skips cases loses 31% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the horizon decay is applied at each close, the orchard audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool as a result watches its influence decay while paying the vault fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 8 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
